goal: Separate real mouse/touch pointer ownership from responsive tablet width so mouse-only fast paths cannot leak into touch or outer-window resize.
contracts: No matchMedia fine-pointer fast-path refs remain in either split workspace.
Actual event.pointerType is latched on pointerdown and cleared on pointerup/cancel.
Mouse-only 661-1080 fast paths require an active mouse gesture.
Touch/pen do not use mouse coalesced-coordinate correction.
Automatic split engine no longer changes live from pointer/hover media-query change events.
Viewport responsive behavior remains live and unchanged.
